metaDescription: AI-native insurance operations for intake, document intelligence, underwriting, rating, policy issuance, premium accounting, and claims.
title: Insurance Operations
intro: Systems for underwriting, rating, policy issuance, accounting, and claims — built for real operation.

sections.heading: From submission to claim.
body: AKETUD builds the systems behind insurance operations: intake, underwriting, rating, policy issuance, accounting, and claims. With evidence, controls, and workflow continuity built in.

steps.heading: Intake & Document Intelligence
steps.body: Turn photos, scans, PDFs, and other submissions into structured insurance data, with each extracted value linked back to its source evidence.

steps.heading: Underwriting workbench
steps.body: Move from submitted risk to underwriting decision through six inspectable stages. Each stage can be reviewed, understood, and stopped without losing the context of the decision.

steps.heading: Rating & Policy Issuance
steps.body: Calculate premiums against effective-dated rating tables, then move through bind, payment, and policy document issuance as one connected workflow.

steps.heading: Premium Accounting
steps.body: Connect written business to premium accounting, giving finance and operations a consistent view of what was bound, billed, collected, and outstanding.

steps.heading: Claims Triage
steps.body: Validate the first notice of loss, assemble the relevant evidence, and route the claim into the next operational workflow before an adjuster begins the file.

cta.line: A system that cannot reconcile is not a system.
